new_today_news.headline: WEFTEC 2026 Water Environment Federation Conference Announced
new_today_news.summary: The Water Environment Federation announced WEFTEC 2026, the largest annual water quality exhibition in North America, scheduled for September 26–30, 2026 in New Orleans. The conference features cutting-edge solutions in water quality treatment and environmental sustainability.

recent_news.headline: Grease Bacterial Solution Tackles Grease Trap Buildup
recent_news.summary: Pumper featured a product article covering a bacterial solution for grease trap maintenance. The article discusses technological solutions for tackling grease accumulation in septic and grease trap systems.

recent_news.headline: FOG-Related Sanitary Sewer Overflows and Consent Decrees: Multi-Year Federal Obligations
recent_news.summary: Article discusses how FOG-related patterns trigger federal consent decrees across municipalities including Baltimore, St. Louis, Miami-Dade, and Fort Smith—establishing multi-year infrastructure obligations with EPA oversight.

recent_news.headline: Tifton-Tift County Landfill and Tifton Inert Landfill Implement Tipping Fee Increase
recent_news.summary: Effective August 1, 2026, tipping fees increased to cover rising operational costs and future capital improvements at municipal landfill facilities.

new_deals.target: Environmental Businesses from Depot Connect International
new_deals.notes: Clean Harbors reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $1.74 billion (up 12%) and net income of $170.5 million ($3.22 EPS), beating analyst estimates. The company announced a major $600 million long-term disposal contract and a $305 million acquisition, raising full-year guidance for Adjusted EBITDA to $1.35–$1.41 billion.
